name: REST API Explorer
author: BerryPress

sections.description:
This plugin provides an easy way to explore the currently registered REST API routes and endpoints along with parameter information for each endpoint. The plugin adds a Tools > REST API Explorer menu item which provides an interactive API exploration interface, listing REST endpoints from WordPress core as well as endpoints registered by plugins. You can provide values for endpoint parameters (where applicable) and run the endpoints in your browser.

How do I access the plugin interface?

The plugin interface can be accessed in the WordPress admin under Tools > REST API Explorer.

1.1.0

  • Show endpoint results inline as pretty-printed JSON, with a green or red status
  • Support every HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) when running endpoints
  • Enter object and array parameters as JSON, with inline validation
  • Add an input for URL path parameters, including ones the route does not declare, and show and check the expected URL format
  • Allow choosing no value for optional enumerated parameters
  • Add a route filter above the navigation tree
  • Scroll to the result after running an endpoint
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1

1.0.3

  • Update plugin header and tested up to version

1.0.2

  • Add an additional permissions check before loading data

1.0.1

  • Add the ability to run REST API routes in the browser

1.0.0

  • Initial release
sections.installation: This plugin can be installed under Plugins > Add New Plugin, either by searching for the plugin title or by downloading the plugin zip file and uploading it via the Upload Plugin feature.
